Question: Identify the antecedent of the following conditional proposition: The Bees win their first game only if either the Aardvarks or the Chipmunks do not win their first games.

Options: 
A. The Bees do not win their first game.
B. Both the Aardvarks and the Chipmunks do not win their first games.
C. The Chipmunks do not win their first game.
D. The Chipmunks win their first game.
E. Both the Aardvarks and the Chipmunks win their first games.
F. Either the Aardvarks or the Chipmunks do not win their first games.
G. The Aardvarks do not win their first game.
H. The Bees win their first game.
I. The Aardvarks win their first game.
J. Either the Aardvarks or the Chipmunks win their first games.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
